epistemic_claim: This slice freezes how raw utterance + projected workspace may be transformed into and evaluated as a ScopeNormalizedProgram. It does not implement or validate any decomposer. It establishes no English→NormalizedProgram accuracy claim.

DecomposerInput.projected_workspace: deterministic ProjectedWorkspace fact projection (same surface MB-02R adjudicates)

curves: aliases/label if part of existing projection

Q1_generation_input_boundary.invariant: Generation inputs must be constructible before consulting the accepted utterance→program oracle.

allowed.version: schema/version metadata only; no semantic outcome
allowed.request: ScopeNormalizedRequest = MB-02R operands + Q1A track_title/track_width_mm + Q4 ScopeSemanticQuery XOR

Q2_decomposer_output_contract.atomicity: One NormalizedTask = one atomic ScopeNormalizedRequest; task count follows required semantic operations, not grammatical clause count or punctuation.
Q2_decomposer_output_contract.oracle_separation: oracle_witness_id is harness-only; candidate must be fully materialized before oracle dereference

order_preserving_alignment.preserves: required causal/utterance order and semantic dependency order
order_preserving_alignment.does_not_require: oracle serialization order of otherwise independent operations
order_preserving_alignment.invariant: oracle task serialization alone cannot establish user-required order

stage_2_semantic_compare.operand_equivalence: resolved semantic referent against corresponding pre-task workspace; aliases OK iff unique same entity
stage_2_semantic_compare.bind_equivalence: α-renamable; bijection preserving kind, producer, consumers, local_ref role, dependency ancestry
stage_2_semantic_compare.scalar_operands: same effective requested values (scale bounds/kind/reverse, title, width, baseline, etc.)

requires_all_of: removing preserves projected facts consumed by later aligned tasks
does not create/remove/change a needed bind or dependency
semantic effect already true at that execution point

SEMANTICALLY_EQUIVALENT_iff: all REQUIRED_REPRESENTABLE utterance semantic atoms covered
OBSERVED_OUT_OF_SCOPE atoms recorded but do not gate equivalence
after permitted benign-redundancy normalization, order-preserving alignment exists over required causal/utterance order
aligned operands denote same semantic values/entities
dependency and bind graphs isomorphic modulo renaming
no semantic overreach or underspecification on the representable surface

coverage_atom_classes.REQUIRED_REPRESENTABLE: gates semantic equivalence; must be expressible on frozen ScopeNormalizedProgram surface
coverage_atom_classes.OBSERVED_OUT_OF_SCOPE: recorded from utterance but absent from frozen program surface; does not gate equivalence; do not expand schema/runtime in this slice

access_order: only then evaluator may access case_id, oracle_witness_id, coverage checklist, expected_terminal, Q3 materials

ordering_atom_allowed_only_if: other semantic dependency stated in utterance
coverage_checklist_rules.ordering_atom_forbidden_if: supported only by oracle task serialization
coverage_checklist_rules.describes: what the user said must be preserved, not how NormalizedProgram must represent it
